title: ENS Foundation Tier A (v1)
summary: Low-value or routine grants where administrative cost must remain minimal. Evidence marshaling only; no merit scoring.

phase2Policy.notes: Omit Phase II unless automated evaluation materially informs a recommendation; if so, escalate toward Tier B/C.

policySourceCapture.notes: Governing-policy URIs required; exact-byte pinning optional at Tier A.

operatorConfirmations.description: Confirm which artifact governs each of the five decision surfaces.
Confirm whether each gate is eligibility versus merit evaluation.
Confirm human/committee decision authority and decision rule.
Confirm whether a missing field is unavailable versus protected.

nonGoals: No merit scoring or approve/reject recommendation engine.
No inference of eligibility from ambiguous prose without operator confirmation.
No automated conflict resolution or quorum invention.
No assignment of institutional authority by the adapter.
No ENS endorsement claim from profile use alone.

burdenBudget.intent: Minimize new artifacts; reuse ordinary workflow outputs.
burdenBudget.notes: Templates may be filled without editing raw JSON.
